newsitem.title: USA: HomeTown sees weaker Q3 performance.
newsitem.headline: HomeTown sees weaker Q3 performance.

text.p: HomeTown Buffet Inc said on Monday its expects third quarter results to be "slightly below" analysts' expectations due to fewer restaurants being open in the first three fiscal quarters.
Fewer openings in the first three quarters will have a negative impact on the third quarter, HomeTown said in a statement.
Final results for the fiscal third quarter, which ends October 9, will be announced on or about October 30, 1996.

HomeTown's previously announced shareholder vote for the proposed merger with Buffets Inc is scheduled for September 19. It the merger is approved by both company's holders and closes, then HomeTown's performance for the third quarter of fiscal 1996 will be reported on a consolidated basis with that of Buffets.

During the remainder of the third quarter, a number of factors could cause actual results to differ from current expectations, including weather conditions and the success of a marketing program, it said.
In addition, the ability of HomeTown to open new restaurants depends on its ability to find suitable locations and negotiate acceptable leases and land purchases.
